triggering_merge_pr.author: codebytes

candidate_merges.message: Add untagged manifest cleanup options to ACR purge tasks (#21720) ## Description Scheduled ACR purge tasks currently remove tags only, leaving manifests and image layers behind. This fixes `WithPurgeTask` to also delete eligible untagged manifests so cleanup can reclaim storage, without adding public API options or changing the existing method signature. - Pin the task image internally to `mcr.microsoft.com/acr/acr-cli:0.21`. - Use `--ago` and `--min-tags` to delete matching tags older than `ago
